name: we_work_remotely-jobs-mcp
description: We Work Remotely (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: We Work Remotely all-jobs RSS 2.0 feed (~80 current remote jobs, ~800 KB). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<company>: <job title>'; location is the WWR region ('Anywhere in the World'); country, skills, category, type and expires_at stay in raw. description is HTML. id is the job link.
